headlines: An AI Plan Beats Video Bingeing
longHeadlines: Daniel Rose watched hundreds of workout videos but still lacked one plan to follow.
Workout videos gave Daniel more information. AI helped organize it into one plan.
See why a specific workout and nutrition plan is more useful than another video.
descriptions: Daniel Rose explains why watching more workouts did not give him one plan to follow.
AI organizes workouts, meals and weekly adjustments into a plan built around you.
A practical look at replacing fitness information overload with one usable plan.
